snippet.title: Together We Move Co-op - One Wrong Move and We Fall Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to the Demo Trailer for our co-op chaos platformer!
In this game, 2–5 players control ONE character together. Everyone gets a different control:

Player 1: Forward
Player 2: Backward
Player 3: Left
Player 4: Right
Player 5: Jump

To clear the hardest parkour sections, you’ll need perfect teamwork… or embrace total chaos 😄
Try the demo and tell us what felt good, what was confusing, and what you want in the full game.

✅ Wishlist on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4424100/

💬 Leave feedback in the comments
